verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of Unity's Profiler, ECS/DOTS, Job System, Burst compiler, or GPU instancing — the core capabilities this story asks about. The only tangential mention (unity-comm-11) is a community comparison implying Unity's profiling is more mature than Godot's, but this is indirect and not first-party evidence of the actual tooling. Missing for 10: Unity Profiler documentation, ECS/DOTS architecture docs, Job System/Burst compiler evidence, GPU instancing support, any performance-scaling case studies.
